title: Shopify UI Update Frustrations
text: As someone who serves as the sole captain of uploading and updating Shopify PIPs - who else HATES the new UI update? The open text field is much more convenient than the + sign prerequisite. We have dozens of metafields, most with single line text. The + button makes it much more difficult and tedious to edit every line of text content. For example: when trying to highlight/select text now within a text box, the UI thinks I’m trying to re-order the metafields, preventing me from being able to highlight text at all. This would be especially time consuming for anyone uploading copy, because instead of one large copy and paste between a document and Shopify, there now as to be individual copies/pastes for each text type - adding about 30-40 minutes to a standard PIP creation that already takes 30 minutes. As someone who creates upwards of 25 PIPs per month and that task being only 10% of my role in Shopify, it creates deep inefficiencies not only creating content, but editing content and see the full view of each metafield now that there is also a “Show More” CTA to visualize the all PIP content. I’ve already submit my feedback with support, but there’s no going back from this update. I feel like they really pulled the rug out from under us with these added clicks, especially with Q4/holiday on the horizon. TIME is critical when it comes to uploading and editing all content. PLEASE Shopify devs: Revert back to the previous metafield entries ASAP. 5 posts - 5 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: A merchant frustrated by a new Shopify UI update making metafield editing tedious.

title: Please allow traditional pocket knives in Shopify Catalog
text: We’re a small shop in eastern Kentucky selling traditional Case XX folding pocket knives, like trappers, stockmen and Sod Buster Jrs. People carry them to work, hand them down and collect them. Shopify Catalog currently excludes “Pocket Collectible Knives,” so only 31 of our 256 products show up there, and the rest can’t be found through Shop, Shop MCP or AI shopping tools. These knives are legal to sell across the US, and Google Merchant Center and eBay list them without trouble. We’d ask Shopify to allow traditional folding pocket knives, separate from tactical or restricted blades. If you sell knives too, please add your voice below. Larry Jude, Pigeon Roost Knives 2 posts - 2 participants Read full topic
triage_reason: A small merchant requesting that traditional folding pocket knives be included in Shopify Catalog.
